examples.japanese: このアルバイトの{時給|じきゅう}は{1000円|せんえん}だ。
examples.english: The hourly wage for this part-time job is 1000 yen.

examples.japanese: {時給|じきゅう}が{上|あ}がった。
{最低|さいてい}{時給|じきゅう}は{地域|ちいき}によって{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The minimum hourly wage differs by region.

notes:
{時給|じきゅう} is an hourly wage, common for part-time and temporary workers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時給|じきゅう}が{高|たか}い / {安|やす}い (hourly wage is high/low)
- {時給|じきゅう}が{上|あ}がる (hourly wage increases)
- {時給|じきゅう}{制|せい} (hourly wage system)
- {最低|さいてい}{時給|じきゅう} (minimum hourly wage)

MINIMUM WAGE:
Japan has regional minimum hourly wages that vary by prefecture. Tokyo tends to have the highest.

TYPICAL USAGE:
- アルバイト (part-time jobs)
- パート (part-time work, often for housewives)
- {派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん} (temporary workers)

CONTRAST:
- {月給|げっきゅう} (monthly salary)
- {日給|にっきゅう} (daily wage)
